description:
EvoPdf Next RTF to PDF Converter for .NET is a component of the EvoPdf Next Library for .NET that enables accurate conversion of complex RTF documents to PDF.

The library targets .NET Standard 2.0 and can be used in .NET Core and .NET Framework applications that you can deploy on Windows and Linux platforms, including Azure App Service and Azure Functions or Docker.

The RTF to PDF Converter is implemented as an add-on for the EvoPdf Next HTML to PDF Converter for .NET component and they must be referenced together in the same project.

You can use it with the EvoPdf Next HTML to PDF Converter NuGet packages EvoPdf.Next.HtmlToPdf.Windows and EvoPdf.Next.HtmlToPdf.Linux for specific target platforms, or with the multi-platform metapackage EvoPdf.Next.HtmlToPdf.

Compatibility:

* Windows 10, 11 and Windows Server 2016 to 2025
* Linux x64 distributions
* .NET 10.0, 9.0, 8.0, 7.0, 6.0 and .NET Standard 2.0
* .NET Framework 4.6.2 to 4.8.1 (where supported)
* Azure App Service and Azure Functions
* Virtual Machines
* Docker containers
* Web, Console and Desktop applications

Main Features:

* Convert RTF documents from memory or from a file to PDF
* Convert RTF content from .NET strings to PDF
* Use custom PDF page settings to automatically reflow the content
* Automatically create a table of contents based on headings in RTF
* Add HTML headers, footers or stamps to the generated PDF
* Control the PDF document display with PDF viewer preferences
* Encrypt, set permissions and set passwords for the generated PDF documents
* Add digital signatures to the generated PDF document
* Asynchronous methods for async and await


Documentation and code samples:
https://www.evopdf.com/evopdf-next-rtf-to-pdf-dotnet
